title: Recover From An Unsupported Operation With A Supported Edit
task: Using docxedit only, inspect a small synthetic table and attempt a delete-column patch on it.
Record the diagnostic code, reason, and help pointer from the failed check.
Recover with a supported edit that achieves the nearest safe visible effect, using cell capabilities and guarded set-cell operations. Run docxedit check before each apply.
Validate the final output with docxedit read and docxedit validate, and state honestly how the recovery differs from the refused structural edit.
successCriteria: Shows the column deletion failing with E4316 before the recovery.
Produces an output .docx through supported guarded edits only.
Does not inspect raw OOXML package parts or quote private document text.
observerQuestions: Did the E4316 diagnostic plus help make the limitation legible?
Could the agent find the cell-level recovery through capabilities?
Did the agent state the clearing-versus-deletion difference honestly?
